method: Live local Storefront Renderer, latest local theme rebuilt before capture. Fresh browser context per theme. CSS viewport 1440×1000, device scale factor 1, reduced motion. Untransformed outer wrapper CSS border box; when no separate wrapper defines the slot, untransformed in-flow CSS layout box. Decorative card rotations do not change the reported slot aspect ratio. No intrinsic image sizes or image transforms used. Ratios are width/height. Distribution groups to two decimal places; exact fractional CSS pixels retained.
